tools.name: search_drills
tools.description: Use this when a golfer asks how to fix a swing fault, asks for golf drills, or wants something to work on at the driving range or at home. Covers: slice, hook, shanks, hitting it fat or thin, topping, over the top, casting, early release, flipping, chicken wing, early extension, standing up, sway, r

tools.name: get_drill
tools.description: Use this when the golfer wants the full instructions for one drill: steps, the cue to remember, reps, equipment and why it works. Takes a drill id from search_drills, diagnose_ball_flight or practice_plan.

tools.name: practice_plan
tools.description: Use this when a golfer asks for a practice plan, a range routine or a session to do at home, e.g. 'build me a 30-minute range plan', 'what should I do with a bucket of balls', 'home practice for tempo'. Builds a timed plan from PocketCaddie drills for 1–3 skills (map their goal to the closest skills

tools.name: diagnose_ball_flight
tools.description: Use this when a golfer describes what the ball does or how they hit it, without naming the swing fault: e.g. 'my ball starts left and curves right', 'everything goes right', 'I keep hitting behind the ball', 'I top it', 'I shanked three in a row', 'my shots are weak and short'. tools.name: about_pocketcaddie
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what PocketCaddie is, how it works, what it measures, which phones and watches it supports, what it costs, or whether an iPhone or Apple Watch can track a golf swing without video. Returns PocketCaddie's own description of itself.

tools.name: recent_sessions
tools.description: List the golfer's most recent PocketCaddie range sessions: date, swings, minutes, sensors used and Swing Score (0–100, needs 15+ swings). Newer sessions report On target instead (the share of swings in range, compared only with the golfer's own normal) with the stats to work on.

tools.name: session_detail
tools.description: Break down one range session: Swing Score, its areas and skill scores when the app synced them, plus the median of each swing measurement (tempo, backswing/downswing time, hip turn, posture; shoulder turn, X-Factor and hand speed with Apple Watch; head stability with AirPods). tools.name: goals
tools.description: Use this when a linked golfer asks about their goals, what they're working on, their focus, or how a block of practice went: the active focus goal (the reading, its zone, who set it, the block so far and the before), the long-term goal, goals waiting in the app, and recent goals with the app's outco

tools.name: rounds
tools.description: Use this when a linked golfer asks about their golf rounds or handicap: recent Live Rounds (course, holes, strokes, to par, putts) and the handicap the PocketCaddie app tracks.

tools.name: coach_plan
tools.description: Use this when a linked golfer asks what their coach assigned: the active PocketCaddie Coach plans, their drills and targets, and progress on each.
